Container.Name: WardenClyffeNet
Container.Overview: WardenClyffeNet is a secure private mesh VPN that creates encrypted tunnels between your servers using X25519 key exchange and ChaCha20-Poly1305 encryption. No WireGuard kernel module needed. Join your Unraid server to your WardenClyffe cluster overlay network.
Container.Description: WardenClyffeNet creates a secure encrypted mesh network between your servers. Run on Unraid to join your WardenClyffe cluster. No WireGuard kernel module required — fully userspace crypto.

Config.Name: Join Token
Config.Description: Invite token from 'wardenclyffenet invite' on an existing node

Config.Name: WardenClyffeNet IP
Config.Description: Override auto-assigned IP (leave empty for auto)

Config.Name: Gateway Mode
Config.Description: Enable NAT gateway for other WardenClyffeNet nodes
